title: 2020 Zagreb earthquake
summary: A very strong earthquake of magnitude 5.5, with its epicentre near Markuševac by Zagreb, struck on the morning of 22 March 2020 and was followed by a 5.0 shock. It injured people in Zagreb and surrounding counties and damaged many central buildings, including most museums, during the coronavirus restrictions.

importance.justification: Damaging national-scale earthquake in a European capital, with many injuries and heavy damage to cultural buildings.
